svg.text: Unreadable plate, no valid booking, no backup bay or aborted passage → kiosk instruction + operator call · a verified arrival is never charged a no-show fee
Motor or obstruction timeout → R9 fault cause + alarm · a recorded entry is never undone
ENTRY_OPEN, ENTRY_WAIT_PASS, the entry timestamp in ENTRY_RECORD, ENTRY_WAIT_CLEAR and the ENTRY_CLOSE obstruction interlock.
ENTRY_WAIT_ACPR, ENTRY_VALIDATE, ENTRY_PREFLIGHT, the backup choice in ENTRY_REASSIGN, and ENTRY_DONE.
commits the ENTRY_REASSIGN swap atomically, or rejects it if the backup bay changed since firmware chose it.
ENTRY_VALIDATE moves the booking HELD → ARRIVAL_PENDING (timer stops). ENTRY_RECORD moves it to ENTERED_NOT_PARKED.
CHECK_SPACE becomes PREFLIGHT (every car already has a bay). STORE_INFO splits into check-in at VALIDATE and entry time at RECORD.
after a verified arrival, ENTRY_ASSIST or ENTRY_FAULT sends the booking to MANUAL_REVIEW, never to NO_SHOW.
